vBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2294: notify the flywheel orchestrator when the operator promotes/merges a UAT train

plan.title: feat(flywheel): notify the flywheel orchestrator when the operator promotes/merges a UAT train
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: On a successful UAT batch promote, postUatGenerationPromotePayload runs firePostMergeLifecycle per member but never signals the running flywheel-orchestrator, which only learns of the merge on its next tick (~1000s later). In that gap the 60s UAT reconciler rebuilds a batch from the stale last-emitted ready set (merged member still shows shipping; the main move regresses remaining ready PRs to pending), so a not-ready train surfaces merge-clickable and clicking it is rejected by the PAN-1759 member-state gate. The gate is correct; the defect is the missing immediate notification.
narratives.Proposal: Add an additive notification hook (no new transport). New module src/lib/cloister/uat-promote-notify.ts exports notifyFlywheelOfUatPromote(result) which, on a successful promote with an active un-paused flywheel run, records a durable JSONL breadcrumb (recordDeaconNudge) and — when the orchestrator tmux session is live — delivers a promote-specific nudge via messageAgent instructing it to re-run its Observe->Act loop immediately (re-derive ready set excluding merged members, re-assemble a clean review+test-passed batch, close out merged issues). All branching lives in the helper; postUatGenerationPromotePayload calls it in one unconditional best-effort awaited line after promote. Reuses the proven stuck-remediation poke mechanism.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not change the PAN-1759 promote member-state gate or the promote/merge git logic.
- Do not change the 60s reconciler cadence or its batch-assembly algorithm.
- Do not build a new message transport, socket, or event bus.
- Do not notify on any event other than a successful UAT generation promote (e.g. individual PR merges).
- Do not guarantee the orchestrator's subsequent actions succeed; this issue only guarantees the notification is delivered/recorded.
- Do not change the PromoteResult shape or the promote HTTP response contract.

autoDecisions.summary: Put all branching (success/active-run/paused/live-session) inside the helper so the call site is one unconditional best-effort line.
autoDecisions.rationale: Makes every branch unit-testable via injected deps and keeps the wiring change trivial and low-risk — an additive hook, not a refactor.

autoDecisions.summary: Reuse messageAgent + recordDeaconNudge; build no new transport.
autoDecisions.rationale: Directly satisfies the issue's explicit constraint and matches the proven stuck-remediation stage-1 orchestrator poke (stuck-remediation.ts:344-345).

autoDecisions.summary: Always record the JSONL breadcrumb when a flywheel run is active, even if the orchestrator session is momentarily dead (delivered=false).
autoDecisions.rationale: Guarantees the merge is recoverable on the orchestrator's next boot and cleanly satisfies the 'no-op safely when no live session' criterion without losing the signal.

autoDecisions.summary: Await the notification (with .catch) rather than fire-and-forget.
autoDecisions.rationale: Deterministic ordering and non-racy tests; the bounded ~5s idle-wait is acceptable latency for a manual operator Merge click.

items.title: Create notifyFlywheelOfUatPromote helper module reusing messageAgent + recordDeaconNudge

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/uat-promote-notify.ts exporting `notifyFlywheelOfUatPromote(result: PromoteResult, deps?: NotifyDeps): Promise<void>`. Import PromoteResult as a type-only import from './uat-promote.js', FLYWHEEL_ORCHESTRATOR_AGENT_ID from './flywheel.js', messageAgent from '../agents.js', recordDeaconNudge from './deacon-nudge-log.js', getFlywheelActiveRunId + isFlywheelGloballyPaused from '../overdeck/control-settings.js', and sessionExistsSync from '../tmux.js' (mirror the imports stuck-remediation.ts already uses). Define NotifyDeps with optional injectable overrides { getActiveRunId, isPaused, sessionExists, message, recordNudge } defaulting to the real implementations, so tests inject fakes. Behavior, all wrapped in a try/catch that swallows errors (best-effort — never rethrow): (1) if result.success !== true, return; (2) if !getActiveRunId(), return; (3) if isPaused(), return; (4) narrow to the success arm and read generation, members, mergeSha; (5) compute delivered = sessionExists(FLYWHEEL_ORCHESTRATOR_AGENT_ID); (6) if delivered, await message(FLYWHEEL_ORCHESTRATOR_AGENT_ID, <nudge>, 'uat-promote-notify') where <nudge> is the promote-specific Observe->Act instruction from the PRD (re-derive ready set EXCLUDING merged members, re-assemble a clean review+test-passed UAT batch, close out merged issues, re-arm next tick, do not ask/pause); (7) always recordNudge({ patrol: 'uat-promote-notify', issueId: members[0] ?? generation, action: 'notified flywheel-orchestrator to re-derive ready set after UAT promote', reason: 'operator promoted a UAT batch; flywheel must immediately rebuild to drop merged + regressed members before its next tick', state: { generation, members, mergeSha, delivered } }). Do NOT wire it into any caller in this bead — that is the next bead.

items.title: Given result.success===true with an active un-paused flywheel run AND a live orchestrator session, notifyFlywheelOfUatPromote delivers a nudge via the injected message dep to FLYWHEEL_ORCHESTRATOR_AGENT_ID and records a deacon nudge with delivered:true.
Given result.success===true with an active run but NO live orchestrator session, the helper records a deacon nudge with delivered:false and does NOT call the message dep.
Given result.success===false, OR no active flywheel run, OR the flywheel globally paused, the helper returns without calling the message dep or the recordNudge dep.
When the injected message dep throws, notifyFlywheelOfUatPromote resolves without throwing (error swallowed, best-effort).
Call notifyFlywheelOfUatPromote from postUatGenerationPromotePayload after a successful promote

expected_outputs: uat-train.test.ts passes including the new promote-notify wiring test

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/server/services/uat-train.ts, import notifyFlywheelOfUatPromote from '../../../lib/cloister/uat-promote-notify.js' and, inside postUatGenerationPromotePayload, capture the promoteUatGeneration(...) result in a const, then before returning it add `await notifyFlywheelOfUatPromote(result).catch(() => {});` (belt-and-suspenders on top of the helper's own internal error swallowing). Return the same result unchanged — the promote HTTP response contract must be identical. Add a test in the existing src/dashboard/server/services/__tests__/uat-train.test.ts (new describe block for postUatGenerationPromotePayload) that mocks '../../../lib/cloister/uat-promote.js' promoteUatGeneration and '../../../lib/cloister/uat-promote-notify.js' notifyFlywheelOfUatPromote via vi.mock, asserting notifyFlywheelOfUatPromote is invoked with the promote result and that postUatGenerationPromotePayload returns that same result object untouched.

items.title: postUatGenerationPromotePayload passes the PromoteResult returned by promoteUatGeneration to notifyFlywheelOfUatPromote (verified by a vi.mock spy in uat-train.test.ts that records the argument).
postUatGenerationPromotePayload returns the exact PromoteResult from promoteUatGeneration, unchanged, whether the promote succeeds or fails (the notification never mutates the response).
When notifyFlywheelOfUatPromote rejects, postUatGenerationPromotePayload still resolves with the promote result (the .catch swallows it), verified by a mock that rejects.
